decisions.reason: As a flagship multi-model line close to the core business, it carries high sunk investment and public commitment, so management is likely to justify and continue it in a growing market.

It fits the established footwear range and can still be defended as part of ongoing innovation, but with less visible commitment and likely lower investment than the larger lines it is more vulnerable than A or C.

As a multi-model safety shoe series near the firm's core offer, it likely absorbed meaningful development resources and is therefore likely to be retained unless clear persistent underperformance emerges.
